script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: He says the sermon ends with people laughing, but Jesus says those who weep now will laugh; the sermon continues beyond that statement.
Saying comfort is not coming later goes beyond Jesus' statement that the rich have already received their comfort.
He comments on how he tells the passage: he says he does not add to Jesus' words.
He comments on how he tells the passage by saying he would hate to add a detail.
The joke compares being struck with a stamper being pressed, making light of the violence in the teaching.
The explanation repeats the verse and calls it difficult but does not explain it.
He assumes the baker has heard the saying many times and knows how it affects them.
Jesus does not say loving people who love you is easy; He says even sinners do it.
Calling reciprocal love the easy kind adds to the text, and saying it is not what Jesus calls for can suggest He excludes loving those who love you.
The explanation says God's kindness is why His sons can love their enemies. Jesus does not state that reason for their ability to love.
